scope: Width comparison, surgery transport, scalar-clock propagation, finite-piece contradiction, and global finite extinction.

sections.title: Widths and deformation input
sections.definitions_and_hypotheses: Compact connected Hausdorff second-countable smooth three-manifold, pi2=0, C1 null loop families, actual Lipschitz disks, free class and based/free identification.
sections.proof_mechanisms: Compact family maximum, class near minimizers; precise two-branch predecessor with positive error on the right.

sections.title: Ordinary-slab width
sections.definitions_and_hypotheses: One nonzero class, fixed compact Ricci-flow slab, short-family and small-disk thresholds chosen before deformation accuracy.
sections.proof_mechanisms: A+(2E+1)e nonnegative from one long member; max(eta,A+(2E+1)e) for the full family; double error limit. Gram determinant and disk transfer imply uniform two-sided metric/width squeeze; derivative of profile gives forward quotient.

sections.title: Class and event transport
sections.definitions_and_hypotheses: Fixed initial class, simply connected parent/child specialization, actual comparison homotopy equivalences, fixed identification and based transport, finite chronology, strict event bounds.
sections.proof_mechanisms: Finite anchor recursion, naturality identifies approximant classes, quadratic Lipschitz area bound, family maximum and class infimum, eta before uniform preterminal neighborhood, additive lower-limit conversion, outgoing right continuity.

sections.title: Scalar comparison and restart
sections.definitions_and_hypotheses: Positive clock, scalar lower bound, nonnegative width, continuous regular slabs, forward slope inequality, finite complete event covering, one fixed global profile.
sections.proof_mechanisms: Exponential strict barrier with last-zero compactness proof; integrating factor; epsilon/2 event closure; finite-set split induction; nonnegative width below negative profile contradiction.

sections.title: Global extinction
sections.definitions_and_hypotheses: One all-time global flow with locally finite events and empty-flow policy; one initial component, metric, basepoint and nonzero class before every target; finite target cover.
sections.proof_mechanisms: Literal initial-component equality yields one w0 for every path; explicit common negative time and value -2pi c^3; target-cover contradiction; maximum of events plus zero; initial nonemptiness, regular identification and no-surgery-after-empty select first empty event.

cross_chapter_contracts.label: prop:filling-loop-identification
cross_chapter_contracts.required: One natural based/free identification, pi2=0 and pi3 class; fixed quotient and coherent basepoint transport.

cross_chapter_contracts.label: sec:filling-short-loops
cross_chapter_contracts.required: Actual Lipschitz filling disks, area continuity, uniform short-family triviality and small-area disks.

cross_chapter_contracts.label: thm:loop-family-deformation
cross_chapter_contracts.required: For every accuracy, same free class, absolute initial area error, pointwise short-or-area alternative with positive error on right.

cross_chapter_contracts.label: thm:comparison-transport
cross_chapter_contracts.required: Simply connected parent/child, same comparison map homotopy equivalence, near-unit smooth based approximants inducing same pi3 map.

cross_chapter_contracts.label: sec:filling-fixed-initial-class
cross_chapter_contracts.required: Literal fixed initial component at every target, one initial class chosen before targets and finite cover by coherent component paths.

cross_chapter_contracts.label: sec:global-assembly
cross_chapter_contracts.required: Same all-time flow, locally finite events, scalar bound, strict comparison schedule and no surgery after an empty slice.

cross_chapter_contracts.label: sec:global-comparison-calibration
cross_chapter_contracts.required: Choose threshold minimum and strict positive antitone control before the one flow; terminal accuracy factor 10^14.
